programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: In 1968, a disastrous American advance in the Vietnam War has Lieutenant Terry Childers executing an unarmed prisoner in order to intimidate a captive Vietnam People's Army officer into calling off an ambush of United States Marine Corps. His act thereby saves the life of the wounded Lieutenant Hayes Hodges though many of Hodges' men die in the battle.

programme.title: Edith
programme.desc: After the death of his wife Edith, Jake feels like he has lost the chance to confront his past. He is convinced that Edith is haunting him for having lived a lie and for having never challenged her about the legitimacy of their son. "Edith" explores how we move on from bereavements. How we make peace with our past and find something worth living for.

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: Foolproof
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

programme.title: Headwinds
programme.desc: Sarah tells Paul that she wants out of their marriage; the next day she disappears. A year later and Paul along with their children return to his childhood town to start anew after the loss of his wife and their mother.

programme.title: Talea
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ambersons
programme.desc: The spoiled rotten and utterly unlikable rich kid George Amberson becomes horrified when his recently widowed mother rekindles her relationship with the wealthy Eugene Morgan, who she left decades earlier in order to marry George's father. As George struggles to sabotage his mother's new romance, he must deal with his own romantic feelings for Morgan's daughter and the consequences of his meddling as his once great family falls into ruin due to his machinations...

programme.title: Second Acts
programme.desc: When a woman reports her daughter as missing, the Blue Heelers find she has moved in with her schoolteacher.

programme.title: Owd Bob
programme.desc: A teen orphan spends the summer on Isle of Man with estranged grandpa. Despite loving dogs, they want summer to end. Boy befriends neighbor girl, but her father has history with grandpa. Locals suspect neighbor's dog kills sheep at night.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: Bernie Lootz (William H. Macy) is a long-time "cooler" at the Shangri-La casino in Las Vegas: he is paid to bring his black cloud to any table where a gambler is on a roll. But when Bernie's luck starts changing for the better--thanks in part to a pretty cocktail waitress--he suddenly loses his cooling talents, incurring the ire of the casino owner in the process.

programme.title: The Humanity Bureau
programme.desc: In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

programme.title: Land Of the Blind
programme.desc: A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

programme.title: Remembrance
programme.desc: Remembrance depicts a remarkable love story that blossomed amidst the terror of a German concentration camp in 1944 Poland. This impossible passion fuels the courage of a Polish prisoner who manages to rescue his Jewish girlfriend. Against all odds, they escape the camp and survive a treacherous journey to freedom. But during the chaos of the end of the war, they are forcibly separated and each is convinced that the other has died. More than thirty years later in New York, the happily married 52-year-old woman accidentally finds out that her former Polish lover is still alive. And she has to see him again.

programme.title: Remembrance
programme.desc: Remembrance depicts a remarkable love story that blossomed amidst the terror of a German concentration camp in 1944 Poland. This impossible passion fuels the courage of a Polish prisoner who manages to rescue his Jewish girlfriend. Against all odds, they escape the camp and survive a treacherous journey to freedom. But during the chaos of the end of the war, they are forcibly separated and each is convinced that the other has died. More than thirty years later in New York, the happily married 52-year-old woman accidentally finds out that her former Polish lover is still alive. And she has to see him again.

programme.title: Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: After his graduation from the University of Toronto, journalist Jay Bahadur in vain tries to gain a foothold in the profession. Still living with his parents, he keeps himself afloat with unsatisfactory activity as a questioner for product placing in supermarkets. A chance appears when his journalistic idol Seymour Tolbin inspires him to realize his dream of journalism not in a conventional way through a post-graduate university education, but through an exciting mission to investigate the backgrounds of piracy in Somalia.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles
programme.desc: The continuing true story of Eric Liddell's glorious life after winning Olympic gold in the 1924 Paris Olympics. Liddell has returned to China, where he was born to missionary parents, modestly avoiding celebrity in order to teach local schoolchildren. In 1937, the Japanese invade China at the outset of WWll. Liddell with his friend Xu Niu, a street smart resistance fighter, recognize the increasing danger so Liddell sends his wife, Florence and their two daughters to safety in Canada. Duty-bound, Liddell stays to minister to the civilian victims. Liddell and other foreign nationals are taken as prisoners and placed in one of the many Japanese internment camps where they are forced to endure for two years. Before the Japanese surrender, Liddell succumbs to a brain tumor. Yet his message of hope became immortal. Eric Liddell's legacy continues to this day as he remains admired as a champion for life.

programme.title: Jungle Boy
programme.desc: In a humble village on the edge of the jungle, a young boy strays from his mother to play with a monkey. Lost in the jungle, he is saved by the great elephant, who will raise him as a member of the great family of animals. When he grows up he helps to protect the jungle from a ruthless poacher.

programme.title: Timber the Treasure Dog
programme.desc: A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Gun
programme.desc: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus).

programme.title: Facing the Enemy
programme.desc: Griff McCleary is a cop, now his son shot himself with Griff's gun. A year later both he and his wife are still reeling from it. Griff feeling shut out by his wife Olivia, decides to move out. Now he is investigating what appears to be a murder-suicide. He believes that there was no suicide. His investigation leads him to a girl named Nikki. It seems that Nikki is a little fragile and has not had much luck with men. When Griff helps her, she asks if she could stay with Griff, and after she and Griff sleep together, she learns that he is a cop and that he has been following her, shattered Nikki shoots herself. Griff is then suspended from the force. But he is unaware that her partner-lover, Harlan, wanting to get back at Griff, is pursuing Olivia, who is vulnerable after hearing what happened between Griff and Nikki.

programme.title: The Tracker
programme.desc: In 2008, Loke Hakansson was taking a family vacation in the south of Italy when his wife and his daughter have been kidnapped. Following an attempt of exchange gone awry both wife and daughter have been killed. Ten years later, Hakansson is contacted by a local detective who has re-opened the case and has new information. Reluctantly, Hakansson travels back to Italy to meet the detective. When he arrives he discovers that the detective has committed "suicide". To his dismay, Hakansson is trapped into a web of deceit that forces him to acts of violence to understand what happened to his family.

programme.title: The Collectors
programme.desc: A crime kingpin decides to settle old scores, and he dispatches two ruthless hit men, Ray (Van Dien) and A.K. (Fox) to collect all unpaid debts. But the pair make a fatal mistake when they opt instead to do a job that will result in the payoff of a huge bundle of cash rather than simply following orders. Soon, they are being tracked by a beautiful detective (Oxenberg), with whom Ray may be mysteriously linked.

programme.title: Loosies
programme.desc: Bobby (Peter Facinelli), a NYC pickpocket who roams the city passing as a stockbroker, tempts fate with the long arm of the law by lifting the badge of a New York City Detective (Michael Madsen) much to the annoyance of his viciously manipulative fence (Vincent Gallo). While playing this dangerous game of cat and mouse, Bobby runs into an even bigger challenge: a recent one-night stand named Lucy (Jaimie Alexander). Three months after their passionate affair Bobby must face reality when Lucy informs him she is pregnant. Suddenly two different worlds collide, forcing Bobby to reevaluate a lifetime of missteps. In a city where he once got by being invisible, Bobby is now very much exposed and hunted by the police.

programme.title: Bolero
programme.desc: 1928. aasta Pariis. Koreograaf Ida Rubinstein tellis Maurice Ravelilt muusika oma järgmise balleti jaoks. Inspiratsioonikriisiga silmitsi seistes vaatab helilooja oma elu uuesti läbi ja pühendub universaalse meistriteose "Bolero" loomisele.

programme.title: Aeg, mis alles jääb
programme.desc: Moefotograaf, kellel on diagnoositud surmaga lõppev vähk, otsustab surra üksi. Ta valmistab oma lähedasi ette eluks pärast tema lahkumist, selle asemel et püüda vältimatut keemiaraviga pikendada või lasta end ümbritseda kaastundest nende poolt, kes tema haigusest teavad.

programme.title: Kirjad Juliale
programme.desc: Romantiline komöödia noortest armunutest Sophie'st ("Mamma mia!" ja "Hüljatute" staar Amanda Seyfried) ja Victorist, kes lähevad romantilisele puhkusele Itaaliasse - maailmakuulsasse "Romeo ja Julia" linna Veronasse. Sophie kätte satub rohkem kui 50 aastat tagasi kirjutatud kiri, kus keegi Claire kirjutab Juliale sellest, kuidas ta oma eluarmastuse käest lasi. Sophie otsustab talle vastata ja tema üllatuseks otsustab Claire (Vanessa Redgrave), kellest on vahepeal saanud juba vanaema, sellest innustust saades samuti Veronasse tulla. Peagi seisab aga Sophie ise sama küsimuse ees - kas päästa oma armastus või jääda elu lõpuni seda taga igatsema?

programme.title: Rahu šokolaadi abil
programme.desc: Südamlik draamakomöödia. Pärast seda, kui tema perekonnale kuuluvat šokolaaditehast tabas pommirahe, püüab noor Süüria põgenik alustada uut elu Kanada väikelinnas. Ta tahaks hakata arstiteadust õppima, ent avab isa nõudmisel siiski šokolaadiäri, mis osutub väga menukaks. Kuid noormehe hinges on siiski lõhe: kas valida omaenda kutsumus või täita muudkui isa soove. Tekkiv pinge ävardab perekonna lõhki rebida… Film põhineb tõestisündinud lool.

programme.title: Adaline'i aeg
programme.desc: Romantiline fantaasiadraama. Adaline Bowman (Blake Lively, "Kõmutüdruk") sünnib 20. sajandi alguses. Noore naisena juhtub temaga aga õnnetus, mille tagajärjel juhtub omalaadne ime - ta ei vanane tulevikus päevagi. Adaline elab edaspidi üksilduses, ennast varjates ja lähedasi suhteid vältides, et tema saladus ilmsiks ei tuleks. Kuid ühel päeva ootab teda ees saatuslik kohtumine sarmika Ellisega (Michiel Huisman, "Metsik"), mis pöörab naise senise rahuliku elu täielikult pea peale…

programme.title: Vääritu sõjapidamise ministeerium
programme.desc: "Vääritu sõjapidamise ministeerium" jutustab uskumatu ja seni kuulmata tõestisündinud loo esimesest eriüksusest, mille asutasid II maailmasõja päevil ÜK peaminister Winston Churchill ja veel mõned sõjaväe ametnikud, kelle seas oli ka kirjanik Ian Fleming. Isepäistest sõduritest koosnev ülisalajane üksus asus natsidega võitlusse täiesti tavatuid ja äärmiselt väärituid võtteid kasutades. Nende julge lähenemine muutis sõja kulgu ja pani aluse Briti SAS-ile ja tänapäevastele salaoperatsioonidele.

programme.title: Tugevam
programme.desc: Inspireeriv tõestisündinud lugu tavalisest mehest Jeff Baumanist, kes võitis kodulinna ja maailma südamed, kui temast sai 2013. aasta Bostoni maratoni plahvatuste järel lootuse sümbol. Jake Gyllenhaali kehastatud 27-aastane töölisklassist Bostoni elanik Jeff oli maratonil, et võita tagasi endist tüdruksõpra Erinit. Ta ootab plahvatuse hetkel finišijoonel ja kaotab seetõttu mõlemad jalad. Jeff aitab haiglas teadvusele tulles politseinikel üht pommipanijat tuvastada, kuid tema enda lahing on alles alanud.

programme.title: Vilistajad
programme.desc: Politseinik Cristi puhul, kes tegutseb seaduse mõlemal poolel, pole miski päriselt see, nagu paistab. Asudes koos kauni Gildaga ellu viima suure panusega röövi, tuleb neil mõlemal orienteeruda korruptsiooni, reeturlikkuse ja pettuse keerulistes keerdkäikudes.

programme.title: Roheline raamat
programme.desc: USA 2018 komöödia, draama Lavastaja: Peter Farrelly Osades: Viggo Mortensen, Mahershala Ali, Linda Cardellini, Don Stark, Sebastian Maniscalco Selle humoorika ja dramaatilise teekonnafilmi aluseks on tõeline sõprus, mis eiras 1960. aastate alguses rassi, klassi ja ühiskondlikke norme. Bronxist pärit väljaviskaja Tony Lip (Mortensen) palgatakse autojuhiks lõunaosariikidesse kontserttuurile suunduvale tipptasemel mustanahalisele pianistile dr. Don Shirley'le (Ali). Teekonnal tuleb neil sõltuda "Rohelisest raamatust", et jõuda vähestesse kohtadesse, mis olid afroameeriklastele ohutud. Seistes silmitsi rassismi, ohu, samuti ootamatu inimlikkuse ja naljaga, on nad sunnitud ellujäämiseks ja elu põnevaimal rännakul edu saavutamiseks oma erimeelsused kõrvale heitma.

programme.desc: 1928. aasta Pariis. Koreograaf Ida Rubinstein tellis Maurice Ravelilt muusika oma järgmise balleti jaoks. Inspiratsioonikriisiga silmitsi seistes vaatab helilooja oma elu uuesti läbi ja pühendub universaalse meistriteose "Bolero" loomisele.

programme.title: Aeg, mis alles jääb
programme.desc: Moefotograaf, kellel on diagnoositud surmaga lõppev vähk, otsustab surra üksi. Ta valmistab oma lähedasi ette eluks pärast tema lahkumist, selle asemel et püüda vältimatut keemiaraviga pikendada või lasta end ümbritseda kaastundest nende poolt, kes tema haigusest teavad.

programme.title: Kirjad Juliale
programme.desc: Romantiline komöödia noortest armunutest Sophie'st ("Mamma mia!" ja "Hüljatute" staar Amanda Seyfried) ja Victorist, kes lähevad romantilisele puhkusele Itaaliasse - maailmakuulsasse "Romeo ja Julia" linna Veronasse. Sophie kätte satub rohkem kui 50 aastat tagasi kirjutatud kiri, kus keegi Claire kirjutab Juliale sellest, kuidas ta oma eluarmastuse käest lasi. Sophie otsustab talle vastata ja tema üllatuseks otsustab Claire (Vanessa Redgrave), kellest on vahepeal saanud juba vanaema, sellest innustust saades samuti Veronasse tulla. Peagi seisab aga Sophie ise sama küsimuse ees - kas päästa oma armastus või jääda elu lõpuni seda taga igatsema?

programme.title: Rahu šokolaadi abil
programme.desc: Südamlik draamakomöödia. Pärast seda, kui tema perekonnale kuuluvat šokolaaditehast tabas pommirahe, püüab noor Süüria põgenik alustada uut elu Kanada väikelinnas. Ta tahaks hakata arstiteadust õppima, ent avab isa nõudmisel siiski šokolaadiäri, mis osutub väga menukaks. Kuid noormehe hinges on siiski lõhe: kas valida omaenda kutsumus või täita muudkui isa soove. Tekkiv pinge ävardab perekonna lõhki rebida… Film põhineb tõestisündinud lool.

programme.title: Adaline'i aeg
programme.desc: Romantiline fantaasiadraama. Adaline Bowman (Blake Lively, "Kõmutüdruk") sünnib 20. sajandi alguses. Noore naisena juhtub temaga aga õnnetus, mille tagajärjel juhtub omalaadne ime - ta ei vanane tulevikus päevagi. Adaline elab edaspidi üksilduses, ennast varjates ja lähedasi suhteid vältides, et tema saladus ilmsiks ei tuleks. Kuid ühel päeva ootab teda ees saatuslik kohtumine sarmika Ellisega (Michiel Huisman, "Metsik"), mis pöörab naise senise rahuliku elu täielikult pea peale…

programme.title: Sõbrantsid
programme.desc: Eluaegsed sõbrad Eden ja Dawn, üks vallaline ja soovib last, teine ​​juba ema, saavad omavahelisele sidemele uusi väljakutseid, kui Eden pärast üheöösuhet üksi rasedaks jääb.

programme.title: Tugevam
programme.desc: Inspireeriv tõestisündinud lugu tavalisest mehest Jeff Baumanist, kes võitis kodulinna ja maailma südamed, kui temast sai 2013. aasta Bostoni maratoni plahvatuste järel lootuse sümbol. Jake Gyllenhaali kehastatud 27-aastane töölisklassist Bostoni elanik Jeff oli maratonil, et võita tagasi endist tüdruksõpra Erinit. Ta ootab plahvatuse hetkel finišijoonel ja kaotab seetõttu mõlemad jalad. Jeff aitab haiglas teadvusele tulles politseinikel üht pommipanijat tuvastada, kuid tema enda lahing on alles alanud.

programme.title: Vilistajad
programme.desc: Politseinik Cristi puhul, kes tegutseb seaduse mõlemal poolel, pole miski päriselt see, nagu paistab. Asudes koos kauni Gildaga ellu viima suure panusega röövi, tuleb neil mõlemal orienteeruda korruptsiooni, reeturlikkuse ja pettuse keerulistes keerdkäikudes.

programme.title: Roheline raamat
programme.desc: USA 2018 komöödia, draama Lavastaja: Peter Farrelly Osades: Viggo Mortensen, Mahershala Ali, Linda Cardellini, Don Stark, Sebastian Maniscalco Selle humoorika ja dramaatilise teekonnafilmi aluseks on tõeline sõprus, mis eiras 1960. aastate alguses rassi, klassi ja ühiskondlikke norme. Bronxist pärit väljaviskaja Tony Lip (Mortensen) palgatakse autojuhiks lõunaosariikidesse kontserttuurile suunduvale tipptasemel mustanahalisele pianistile dr. Don Shirley'le (Ali). Teekonnal tuleb neil sõltuda "Rohelisest raamatust", et jõuda vähestesse kohtadesse, mis olid afroameeriklastele ohutud. Seistes silmitsi rassismi, ohu, samuti ootamatu inimlikkuse ja naljaga, on nad sunnitud ellujäämiseks ja elu põnevaimal rännakul edu saavutamiseks oma erimeelsused kõrvale heitma.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is hosting a cooking and eating get-together with her Oklahoma City Thunder gal friends. They're teaming up to cook a great spring menu of White Spinach Artichoke Lasagna with a Butternut and Kale Salad -- two easy dishes perfect for effortless entertaining. Afterward, they're sipping Thunder Margaritas in the team colors and wrapping up the party with self-assembly Boozy Berries and Cream.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Kitchen Chaos
programme.desc: Chefs like Damaris Phillips, Joe Isidori and Arnold Myint react with hilarious commentary and culinary expertise as they break down massive food creations, sushi blunders, and dessert recipes that should have stayed off the internet.

programme.title: Kitchen Chaos
programme.desc: Kitchen Chaos dives headfirst into the wild, unpredictable world of food with viral moments of jaw-dropping culinary triumphs and spectacular meltdowns. Think hibachi tricks gone wildly off the rails to bizarre and unhinged food recipes that must be seen to be believed.

programme.title: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: Five talented cookie makers reveal who's on Santa's list by creating one cookie that shows someone doing a good deed and another with someone being naughty. Hosts Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson decide who ends up on Santa's good side and which naughty cookie-maker goes home. In round two, the cookiers create the nicest displays of all -- cookie angel figurines. They'll have to use good spirits in their festive figurines, like cinnamon schnapps, mezcal, honey liqueur and white chocolate liqueur. When the heavens clear, only one cookie maker will emerge with the $10,000 prize and the title of Christmas Cookie Champion.

programme.title: The Kitchen: Qatar Special
programme.desc: To celebrate the Middle East's incredible food, the hosts visit the Qatar International Food Festival and share delicious regional dishes.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is sharing a trio of dinners for two—for her daughter, Paige, for the freezer, and for her other half, Ladd. Ree's mother-daughter dinner is an all-in-one Spatchcock Chicken Sheet Pan Supper. Next, her layered Loaf Pan Lasagna is perfectly portioned for two and just the thing for stocking up the freezer. Then, Ree and Ladd cook up frontier-style Steak Frites and Oven Fries with Ladd's own Lemon and Pepper Seasoning and Easy Hollandaise.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: There's a flurry of activity on the ranch for a calf working, so Ree Drummond is preparing a well-deserved lunch at the lodge for the cowboy crew. She makes a crispy-coated ranch favorite, Chicken Fried Steak Sliders piled on beautiful, warm Buttermilk Biscuits and served with Buttermilk Gravy. Her Perfect Fried Potatoes are a tasty and filling side dish. For dessert, Ree makes Cherry Pie Cookie Bars, the perfect sweet treat for the crew to enjoy as they head back to work.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Buried in debt, Habanera and the Guero in Houston, Texas, is on the verge of closing. The infighting is destroying the business and a 3-year-old daughter is stuck in the middle. Robert Irvine will have to convince the owner, Ben, to step back from the obsessive control of his partner and chef, Vanessa, and concentrate on the rest of the restaurant, or Ben will lose both his business and his family.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: Supermarket Stakeout is an American cooking competition TV series presented by chef Alex Guarnaschelli. Every participant of the show has a budget of $500 to purchase the groceries from the customers of a nearby supermarket, and create dishes later out of it. In each round the host assigns the theme of the dish to cook. The chef whose dish is judged the least satisfactory is eliminated from the competition, and the final chef remaining gets a prize of $10,000.

programme.title: Chopped Castaways
programme.desc: The nine remaining chefs must choose their weapons and hit their targets to earn high-value ingredients. In a relay-style cook, each team creates one cohesive dish built around a showstopping basket, and the losing team is sent to a brutal Gauntlet.

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship

To survive the challenges from week to week, they must prove their abilities in front of our tough-love judges: Duff Goldman, Nancy Fuller and Lorraine Pascale. Hosted by Bobby Deen, this baking championship is the sweetest way to celebrate this holiday season.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped Castaways
programme.desc: The nine remaining chefs must choose their weapons and hit their targets to earn high-value ingredients. In a relay-style cook, each team creates one cohesive dish built around a showstopping basket, and the losing team is sent to a brutal Gauntlet.

programme.title: Holiday Wars
programme.desc: Host Jeff Mauro challenges the three remaining teams to create a scene that features adorable woodland animals going for gold in an Olympic event. This time, the sugar artist is in the hot seat, as each display must incorporate woodland décor made entirely of sugar! Judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown determine which two teams head to the finale, where they will battle it out for the title of Holiday Wars champion and $25,000!

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is sharing a trio of dinners for two—for her daughter, Paige, for the freezer, and for her other half, Ladd. Ree's mother-daughter dinner is an all-in-one Spatchcock Chicken Sheet Pan Supper. Next, her layered Loaf Pan Lasagna is perfectly portioned for two and just the thing for stocking up the freezer. Then, Ree and Ladd cook up frontier-style Steak Frites and Oven Fries with Ladd's own Lemon and Pepper Seasoning and Easy Hollandaise.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: There's a flurry of activity on the ranch for a calf working, so Ree Drummond is preparing a well-deserved lunch at the lodge for the cowboy crew. She makes a crispy-coated ranch favorite, Chicken Fried Steak Sliders piled on beautiful, warm Buttermilk Biscuits and served with Buttermilk Gravy. Her Perfect Fried Potatoes are a tasty and filling side dish. For dessert, Ree makes Cherry Pie Cookie Bars, the perfect sweet treat for the crew to enjoy as they head back to work.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Buried in debt, Habanera and the Guero in Houston, Texas, is on the verge of closing. The infighting is destroying the business and a 3-year-old daughter is stuck in the middle. Robert Irvine will have to convince the owner, Ben, to step back from the obsessive control of his partner and chef, Vanessa, and concentrate on the rest of the restaurant, or Ben will lose both his business and his family.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: Sun's out, grills out! Michael Symon soaks up the summertime weather and fires up his grill to encourage everyone to get cooking out with his easy and crowd-pleasing outdoor dinners. From sticky ribs to desserts, Michael shares his grilling tips and tricks to make every meal flamingly delicious. Self-shot from his New York backyard, cook along with Michael as he works live fire to show how simple and fun it is to make amazing dishes on the outdoor grill.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez's culinary adventure takes her to Beverly Hills, the home of Chef Wolfgang Puck's gorgeous CUT steakhouse. Wolfgang gives Selena two kitchen initiation tests, starting with a deceptively simple challenge that throws her and Raquelle into blind panic. After making one of his classic dishes, Selena gets the chance to create her own take on a spicy seafood dish for his menu, but only if Wolfgang doesn't give it the cut.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Start the clock -- Ree Drummond is whipping up four 16-minute Tex-Mex marvels for breakfast, lunch, dinner and a snack. She makes a fried egg-topped Breakfast Tostada for a speedy and satisfying start to the day. Then she whips up Pineapple Chicken Tacos for a lunch date with a friend. For dinner on a deadline, Ree turns to a beautiful bowl of Pozole with plenty of fixings, and she makes a sweet snack in a snap, Quick Churros with Caramel Sauce, for dessert with her husband, Ladd.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Four competitors think they're ready for whatever the Chopped kitchen might throw at them! In a dynamic first round, the chefs have a lot of ideas for their turkey legs and milkshakes, but they struggle to keep pace with the clock. Then in a drama-filled second round, the chefs rush to make steak work with a wacky candied surprise. When the final two chefs open the dessert basket and find a lot of frosting and a freeze-dried fruit, they must wrap their heads around the challenge in time to make terrific final plates.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible

programme.title: Selena + Chef: Home For the Holidays
programme.desc: It's a surf-and-turf Christmas Eve as Chef Michael Symon joins Selena Gomez in the kitchen. They bond over a shared struggle before tackling a menu that includes giant juicy Smoked and Reverse-Seared Steaks and luxurious Lobster with Homemade Pasta. Raquelle assists by eating as much cheese as she grates, while a Escarole Salad with Anchovy Vinaigrette and Croutons challenges Selena to overcome a mental block.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: Actor Christine Baranski stops by Ina Garten's barn to talk Broadway breaks, love at first sight, and living the Italian dream. Ina makes maple-oatmeal scones, and they take a culinary trip to Italy by cooking weeknight Bolognese and roasted broccolini.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: Legendary violinist Itzhak Perlman joins Ina Garten for cooking and conversation, and Ina makes a potato galette with smoked salmon. Then, Itzhak shares his foolproof scrambled eggs with caramelised onions to pair with Ina's strawberries Romanoff.

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship

Hosted by Bobby Deen, this baking championship is the sweetest way to celebrate this holiday season.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

Their designs may be big, but the bakers will have to incorporate extra-small ingredients like sesame seeds, pine nuts, pumpkin seeds and sunflower seeds into their displays. The cookie maker who makes the most extraordinary, extra-large ornament will win the $10,000 prize and the title of Christmas Cookie Champion.

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship
programme.desc: The search to find the greatest holiday baker begins as eight amateur bakers enter the kitchen, where they show off their family traditions and superb baking skills. To survive the challenges from week to week, they must prove their abilities in front of our tough-love judges: Duff Goldman, Nancy Fuller and Lorraine Pascale. Hosted by Bobby Deen, this baking championship is the sweetest way to celebrate this holiday season.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez and Raquelle meet up with Chef Marcel Vigneron at his Hollywood hotspot, Lemon Grove. Marcel greets Selena with three of his favorite dishes that set the bar for how good her dish will need to be to make the menu! While Raquelle discovers the delights of the professional walk-in refrigerator, Selena creates a colorful dish using some very unusual ingredients. The ultimate decision is down to Marcel and his team on whether her purple plate will be their new special or just a color bomb.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez must step up her game as she enters the Girl & the Goat, owned by the only person ever to win both Iron Chef and Top Chef, Stephanie Izard. Stephanie challenges and inspires Selena's taste buds with a blind taste test. Then for her special, Selena creates a ricotta toast dish based on her love of cheese and crackers in hopes of dazzling Stephanie with a cheesy, crunchy creation.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: As she prepares to open a boarding house, Ree Drummond is road-testing mini bar snacks on the managers. Her first treat is Tallgrass Toffee, a mashup of candy, chocolate and trail mix. Then she makes Chocolatey Apricots, a simple combo of dried fruit and the good stuff. There are cute, homey Sprinkle Cookies and crispy, salty Drummond Ranch Potato Chips, too. She rounds out her boarding house snacks ready for room service with savory, spicy Cowboy Cheese Bites.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is upping her potluck game with four fabulous portable ideas for barbecue season. Her 8-Layer Dip takes snacking to the next level with its grown-up flavors. Then there's an awesome salad duo -- BBQ Potato Salad that turns a classic into a buffet must-have and Blueberry Cornbread Panzanella that's certain to be the star of any spread. Ree has desserts covered, too, with a refreshing Lemon Icebox Pie that's a sweet ending for any get-together.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Kids Sweets Showdown
programme.desc: Nearly all kids love to eat sweet treats, but how many can make them? In this cooking competition series hosted by Alisson Sweeney, Sharone Hakman and Harley Morenstein, young bakers are invited to showcase their culinary talents for a slice of a hefty $10,000 cash prize. Two pairs of kids go head to head in a primary baking competition, whilst there are also "sugar rush" challenges, where the young bakers have a limited amount of time to create something delicious. Each of the dishes are judged and scored, with the best performing duo taking home the cash.

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship
programme.desc: Host Jesse Palmer welcomes 12 amazing bakers to the gorgeous holiday village, where the bakers are divided into the Nice Team and the Naughty Team. In each bake, there will be a top dessert from each team, and the best overall dessert wins for their team. In elimination challenges, the winning team is safe from elimination, and the losing team loses a baker. For the first preheat challenge, the Nice Team makes warm and toasty desserts, while the Naughty Team makes chill and frosty treats. Then, Jesse asks each team to create an edible holiday village that includes a dessert from every baker. Judges Duff Goldman, Nancy Fuller, and Kardea Brown decide which baker from the losing team will be eliminated.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

Väljapääsu pole
programme.desc: Lumetorm on mitu võõrast inimest jätnud lõksu teeäärsesse peatuspaika. Üks võõrastest on röövinud lapse. Aga kes on süüdlane?

programme.title: Tulnukas: Romulus
programme.desc: Legendaarse "Tulnuka" ulmeõudusseeria algusaegadesse viiv lugu jutustab noortest kosmoseränduritest, kes satuvad vastamisi kõigi aegade hirmsama eluvormiga universumis.

programme.title: Venom: viimane tants
programme.desc: Tom Hardy kehastab triloogia viimases filmis "Venom: viimane tants" taas Marveli vägevaimat ja keerukaimat tegelaskuju Venomit. Eddie ja Venom on põgenikud, keda jahivad mõlemad maailmad. Kui võrk koomale tõmbub, tuleb duol langetada raske otsus, mis viib Venomi ja Eddie viimase tantsuni.

programme.title: Ford v Ferrari
programme.desc: Oscari-võitjad Matt Damon ja Christian Bale kehastavad peaosi selles tõsielul põhinevas põnevas loos ajast, mil Ford Ferrari vastu sõtta läks. See on lugu lennuka visiooniga autoehitajast Carroll Shelbyst (Damon) ja kartmatust võidusõitjast Ken Milesist (Bale), kes trotsisid suurkorporatsiooni bürokraatiat, füüsikaseadusi ja isiklikke deemoneid, et ehitada Ford Motor Company jaoks revolutsiooniline võidusõiduauto, millega minna vastu Enzo Ferrari loodud võidukatele neljarattalistele Prantsusmaal, legendaarsel Le Mans'i 24 tunni võidusõidul.

programme.title: Jääaeg 2: Suur sula
programme.desc: EESTI KEELES! Lustakas järg kõigi aegade edukaimale animafilmile Eesti kinodes! Sõbrad eelmisest osast on tagasi ja seekord seisavad nad veel suurema probleemi ees - jääaeg on lõppemas ja jää hakkab sulama. Selle tagajärjel on nende org hävinemas ning Mafred, Diego ja Sid peavad kõiki hoiatama. Vanade tuttavate kõrval kohtame ka uusi vahvaid tegelasi. Loomulikult on platsis ka üks närviline tegelane, kes ikka veel oma pähklile peidupaika otsib. Osades (hääled) : Anu Lamp, Marko Matvere, Lembit Ulfsak jt Lavastaja: Carlos Saldanha.

programme.title: Pahalased 2
programme.desc: Kõigi lemmikkurjategijad on tagasi ja seekord pole nad omapead. Härra Hundi juhtimisel kuritegelikus maailmas kõik saavutanud Pahalased on nüüdseks kõvasti vaeva näinud, et saada "heaks". Aga paraku on saatusel neile varuks midagi muud. Vastu tahtmist kistakse nad kõrgete panustega, lausa ülemaailmse haardega röövi, mille taga seninägematu koosseis: pahad... tüdrukud!

programme.title: Rio
programme.desc: USA 2011 animakomöödia Lavastaja: Carlos Saldanha Osades (hääled): Andero Ermel, Evelin Pang, Hannes Urbla, Mirtel Pohla, Tõnu Oja, Tiit Sukk, Janek Joost, Kait Kall, Karol Kuntsel, Taavi Teplenkov, Tarvo Krall, Elina Pähklimägi, Indrek Ojari, Tõnn Lamp, Anne Reemann, Juss Haasma jpt. Blu on haruldasest liigist sinine makao, kes elab ühes Minnesota vaikses raamatupoes. Ta arvab, et ta on viimane tema liigist makao, kuniks ta kuuleb, et Rio de Janeiros elab veel üks teine sinine makao, Jewel, kes pealekauba on veel emane. Selle tõttu viiakse ta Rio de Janeirosse, kus ta peab emasega paarituma, et tema liik ei sureks välja. Kuid seal olles röövitakse nii Blu kui ka Jewel röövlite poolt, kes tahavad nüüd nende eest lunaraha nõuda. Kuid õnneks imekombel saavad nad põgenema. Põgenemisest saati üritavad nüüd makaod üles leida Blu omaniku ning selle vältel peab Blu hakkama silmitsi seisma ka enda suurima hirmuga, lendamisega. "Rio" on animatsioon, mis sisaldab endas nii komöödiat kui ka seiklust. Film on loodud "Jääaja" triloogia loojate poolt.

programme.title: Varjatud kuningriik
programme.desc: VARJATUD KUNINGRIIK on lennukas ja naljakas animaseiklus, mis viib vaataja peidetud maailma, millesarnast keegi pole varem näinud. "Jääaja" ja "Rio" loojate film jutustab loo ammusest võitlusest, milles on vastamisi headuse jõud, kes kaitsevad loodust ja hoolitsevad meid ümbritseva keskkonna tervise eest, ning kurjuse väed, kes püüavad seda kõike hävitada. Kui teismeline tüdruk leiab end korraga sellest varjatud kuningriigist, peab ta ühinema naljakate ja kangelaslike tegelaskujudega, et päästa nende maailm… ja seda tehes ka meie oma.

programme.title: Tüdruk nimega Willow
programme.desc: Willow avastab oma vanatädile Alwinale kuulunud metsast kirja, milles paljastatakse ta pärinemine nõidadest. Seepeale tuleb Willow'l endas nõiavõimed äratada ja veel kolme nõia abiga maagiline mets päästa, enne kui aeg otsa saab ja tragöödia aset leiab. Film põhineb Sabine Bohlmanni populaarsel raamatusarjal.

programme.title: Ingrid kolib Los Angelesse
programme.desc: USA 2019 draama komöödia Lavastaja:Matt Spicer Osades:Aubrey Plaza,Elizabeth Olsen Ingrid Thornburn on sotsiaalmeedias tuntud jälitaja, kes kolib LA-sse,et jälitada veelgi lähemalt oma lemmikuid staare.

programme.title: Kahjustatud
programme.desc: Chicago detektiiv Dan Lawson reisib Šotimaale, et luua sidemeid šoti detektiivi Glen Boydiga pärast sarimõrvari taaselustamist, kelle kuriteod vastavad lahendamata juhtumile, mida ta uuris viis aastat varem.

programme.title: Aardekütid
programme.desc: Kui tohutu päikesepurse hävitab Maa idapoolkera, palgatakse vapper aardekütt Euroopast ihaldatud "Mona Lisat" otsima. Ta avastab aga seikluse käigus, et maailm vajab maalist enam hoopis kangelast. Peaosades Dave Bautista, Olga Kurylenko ja Samuel L. Jackson.

programme.title: Näoga mööda asfalti
programme.desc: Mida on üks mees valmis keerulisse olukorda sattudes tegema, et kanda hoolt oma perekonna eest?Selle probleemiga põrkab ühel päeval kokku karmikäeline "vana kooli" politseinik Brett Ridgeman (Mel Gibson), kes ühes oma lühikest süütenööri omava noorema paarimehe Anthony Lurasettiga (Vince Vaughn) on üht järjekordselt kahtlusalust tavapärasest veidi karmimalt kohelnud kui võib-olla viisakas oleks. Võib-olla poleks sellest muidu suurt midagi, üks inimjätis sai avansina paar võmmu, aga see kõik on toimunud uudishimuliku pealtnägija mobiiltelefoni filmimisulatuses ja peatselt on klipp sotsiaalmeedias ning õhtustes uudistes laineid löömas. Lavastaja: S.Craig Zahler Osades:Jennifer Carpenter, Mel Gibson, Vince Vaughn

programme.title: Oopus
programme.desc: Noor kirjanik (Ayo Edebiri) kutsutakse kolmekümne aasta eest salapäraselt kadunud legendaarse popstaari (John Malkovich) kõigest eraldatud kompleksi, kus ta leiab end lipitsejate ja joobes ajakirjanike seltsis viibides staari veidra plaani keskmest.

programme.title: Terra Willy: Tundmatu planeet
programme.desc: Mängufilm jutustab loo Willyst, noorest kosmoseuurijast, kes on oma vanematest eraldatud pärast nende laeva hävitamist. Koos oma ellujäämisroboti Bucki ja armastusväärse tulnuka nimega Flashiga peab Willy ellu jääma metsikul, tundmatul planeedil. Koos uurivad nad selle kaardistamata universumi ilu ja ohte, pakkudes avastamisrikka elamuse.

programme.title: Marsupilami
programme.desc: Loomaia töötaja satub pöörasesse seiklusse, kui haruldane olend pääseb vabadusse ja paiskab tema pere kaose keerisesse.

programme.title: Miisu Moxy
programme.desc: Miisu Moxy on kodukass, kel tuleb Euroopas puhkusereisil kadudes taas oma pere juurde jõuda. Tal aitavad seda teha kaks kassile jälestusväärseimat olendit - rumal koer ja vana lind. Moxy vaated elule muutuvad sel teekonnal ja ta avastab sõpruse tõelise tähenduse.

programme.title: Tossud
programme.desc: "Tossud" on südamlikkust, huumorit ja hiphopi energiat täis särtsakas kogupere animafilm. Kui kaks ainulaadset tossu suurlinnas lahku satuvad, tuleb neil sõltuda vaprusest, sõprusest ja tänavatarkusest, et teineteist taas leida. Nad kohtavad sel teel unustamatuid tegelasi, avastavad uusi maailmu ja saavad teada, et elu suurim seiklus algab, kui julged oma mugavustsoonist lahkuda.

programme.title: Johnny Puff: Salajane missioon
programme.desc: Jälgib Johnny Puffi ja tema sõpru, kui nad asuvad salajasele missioonile päästma Taigasville'i Otto von Walruse kurjade plaanide käest.

programme.title: Jääaeg 3
programme.desc: Jääaeg kestab ikka veel ning kõva külma ja ohtra lumega harjunud seltskond elab oma elu. Scrat üritab endiselt tabada ihadusväärset tammetõru (kusjuures seda tehes tekib lootus leida ka tõeline armastus), Manny ja Ellie ootavad oma minimammuti sündi, laiskloom Sid satub pahandustesse, kui veab omale peret luues koopast välja kolm saurusemuna. Mõõkhambuline tiiger Diego aga kahtleb, kas selles seltskonnas liikumine teda liiga pehmeks pole teinud. Pärast seda, kui juhmivõitu Sid kaob allpool jääd ja lund asuvasse salapärasesse maailma, asuvad sõbrad teda päästma. Seda tehes puutuvad nad kokku nii lendavate kui sammuvate dinosaurustega, võitlevad elusloodusega ja leiavad endale uue kartmatu abilise, kelle elu sisuks on kassi-hiire-mäng suurte kiskjatega. EESTI KEELES!

programme.title: Visa hing
programme.desc: New Yorgi võmm John McLaine (Bruce Willis) saabub jõulude ajal Los Angelesse, kuhu tema abikaasa on elama asunud, et uues Nakatomi korporatsioonis karjääri teha. Perekonna rõõmuküllane taasühinemine katkestatakse kõige ootamatumal ja jõhkramal moel, kui pilvelõhkuja võtavad enda kontrolli alla Euroopa päritolu terroristid, eesotsas jõhkra ning sihikindla Hans Gruberiga (Alan Rickman). Pantvangide ainsaks pääsemise lootuseks jääb kurjamite eest varjunud McLaine, kes alustab pealtnäha lootusetut võitlust hambuni relvastatud terroristidega.

programme.title: Visa hing 2
programme.desc: Suur rahvusvaheline lennuväli saab terroristide mänguväljaks, kui detektiiv John McClane haaratakse eluohtlikku kassi-hiire mängu. Washingtonis asuva lennuvälja on enda kontrolli alla võtnud eriüksus, mille liidriks on maniakaalne endine USA sõjaväe ohvitser. Nende plaan on kiire, julm ja geniaalne, kuid nad ei arvesta ühe asjaga - kui kohal on detektiiv John McClane, ei lähe miski nii nagu kavatsetud.

programme.title: Barry Seal: Mees üle Ameerika
programme.desc: USA / Jaapan / Kolumbia 2017 märul / komöödia Lavastaja:Doug Liman Osades:Tom Cruise, Domhnall Gleeson, Sarah Wright Barry Seal oli lendur, kes palgati 1978. aastal CIA poolt agendiks varjunimega Monty Schafer. Barry vedas peatselt relvasid Panamasse, ent Medellini kartell palkas ta samas USA-sse kokaiini vedama. Barry teenis koos oma naise Lucyga nii palju raha, et nad matsid selle oma aeda. Kui CIA operatsiooni lõpetas, sattus Barry CIA, narkopolitsei ja Pablo Escobari sihikule. Asjad võtsid veelgi pöörasema suuna, kui ta üritas Valgelt Majalt armu paluda.

programme.title: Kodusõda
programme.desc: Ameeriklaste eelmine kodusõda lõppes aastal 1865. Uus on kohe algamas... Oma tumedate tulevikunägemuste poolest tuntud lavastaja ja stsenarist Alex Garland ("Ex Machina", "Annihilation") viib vaataja närvesöövale teekonnale läbi lõhestunud Ameerika, mis kõigub nagu noateral pääsemise ja täieliku hävingu vahel.

programme.title: Wallise saare ballaad
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline lotovõitja, kes elab üksi kaugel saarel, otsustab oma unistused teoks teha, lastes oma lemmikmuusikutel kodus esineda!

programme.title: Koermees
programme.desc: Lugu algab, kui politseinik ja tema ustav neljlajalgne abilmees saavad tööülesannete käigus viga. Hullumeelse idee ja keerulise operatsiooni tulemusel sünnib seninägematu, seadust ja korda kaitsev, aga ka sitsiv ja palli taga ajav kangelane, Koermees! Tema suurimaks väljakutseks saab võitlus kurja kassiga, kes ei kohku oma eesmärkide saavutamise nimel tagasi ühegi alatu võtte eest, peaasi, et saaks kurja teha.

programme.title: Jääaeg
programme.desc: USA 2002 perefilm Lavastaja: Chris Wedge Osades (hääled): Marko Matvere, Lembit Ulfsak, Anu Lamp, Aarne Üksküla, Peeter Oja jpt. 20 000 aasta eest oli maailm kattumas jääga ning loomad põgenesid pealetungiva külma massi eest, kuhu said. Sel ohtlikul ajal moodustub kõige kummalisemat sorti kari, mille liikmeteks on kiire jutuga juhmivõitu laiskloom Sid, rahulik, aga pahuravõitu mammut Manfred ja kurikaval tiiger Diego. Neid seob soov viia eksinud inimlaps tagasi oma vanemate juurde. Seistes silmitsi lugematute ohtudega, liigub see kirju seltskond läbi koomiliste sekelduste sammhaaval oma eesmärgi suunas, puutudes aeg-ajalt kokku hüsteerilise oravaga, kes on pidevalt mures oma kalli tammetõru pärast. "Jääaeg" on lustiline komöödia kogu perele, mille muudab eriliseks tõsiasi, et FILMI TEGELASED RÄÄGIVAD EESTI KEELES!!

programme.title: Jääaeg 4
programme.desc: Osades (hääled): Lembit Ulfsak, Anu Lamp, Ivo Uukkivi, Janek Joost, Evelin Võigemast, Kristjan Üksküla, Lenna Kuurmaa, Kärt Kross, Kati Ong ja Helene Vannari. Meie lemmiktegelaste elu on veerenud vahepealsetel aastatel vaikselt oma rada, kuid vaikusest lugu pidav mammut Manny on pidanud viimasel ajal tegemist tegema oma murdeikka jõudnud tütrekese Virsiku kasvuraskustega. Kuid enne, kui isa ja tütar jõuavad hakata teineteisest üha kaugemale triivima, sekkub taas kord kõikvõimas loodus - sedapuhku kolossaalse maanihke näol, mille tulemusena tekkisid siia ilma erinevad kontinendid. Nimetatud maanihke tulemusena leiab Manny end järsku jääkamakalt, mis kiires tempos maismaast ning ühtlasi ka tema perekonnast kaugeneb. Õnneks on samale jääpangale lõksu jäänud ka tema vana sõber Diego ning muidugi ka aastatega üha laisemaks jääv laiskloom Sid ühes oma vanaemaga, kelle Sidi perekond ühel hetkel kohale toimetas ja seejärel sedamaid hülgas. Kui esmalt on meie sõprade esmaseks sooviks kojujõudmine, siis peatselt lisandub sellele ka tuline soov ellu jääda, sest silmapiirile ilmub päästva rannajoone asemel hoopiski laev hambuni relvastatud piraatidega, kelle ninemeheks on armutu Kapten Kõht. Nii muutubki esialgne soov koju tagasi jõuda korraga sootuks keerulisemaks. Ees ootavad peadpööritavad seiklused! Oma tuleproovi dubleerimisel said ka Sirje Eesmaa, Marek Lindmaa, Erkki Sarapuu ja Annely Adermann. Kuigi esialgu arvasid teletegijad, et algajate dubleerijatena oleks neile jõukohane eelkõige massistseenides häält teha, usaldasid asjatundjad ehk filmistuudio 20th Century Fox kohalik esindaja Timo Diener levifirmast Forum Cinemas ning produtsent Jette Aus neile lausa terveid lauseid. Näiteks Sirje Eesmaa häälega on öeldud: "Ma tahan snäkki!"; Marek Lindmaalt kuuleb torinat: "Vastupidavusalad pole just minu rida ja kogu see värk on siin nii mõttetu…"; Erkki Sarapuu hüüatab: "Ma olen väsinud nuusutamast seda saba minu ees!" ning Annely Adermann õhkab: "Sid! Ma jumaldan mehi, kes ei hooli kehahügieenist!", "Sid, mul on väike snäkk su jaoks…öäkkk!" ja hädaldab: "Kas oleme juba kohal? Oleme terve päeva kõndinud!"

programme.title: Hotell Transilvaania
programme.desc: Welcome to Hotel Transylvania, Dracula's lavish five-stake resort, where monsters and their families can live it up and no humans are allowed. One special weekend, Dracula has invited all his best friends to celebrate his beloved daughter Mavis's 118th birthday. For Dracula catering to all of these legendary monsters is no problem but the party really starts when one ordinary guy stumbles into the hotel and changes everything!

programme.title: Mõrv Idaekspressis
programme.desc: Malta / USA 2017 Draama/krimi/müsteerium Lavastaja:Kenneth Branagh Osades:Kenneth Branagh, Johnny Depp, Daisy Ridley, Judi Dench, Willem Dafoe, Penelope Cruz, Michelle Pfeiffer, Josh Gad, Derek Jacobi, Olivia Colman Luksuslikust rongisõidust läbi talvise Euroopa saab ühel ööl verdtarretav mõrvamüsteerium. See on lugu kolmeteistkümnest võõrast, kes on rongiga lumevangis, sealsamas toime pandud mõrvast ning maailma parimast detektiivist nimega Hercule Poirot (Kenneth Branagh), kes peab ajaga võidu joostes lahendama selle juhtumi olukorras, kui kõik tema ümber on kahtlusalused.

programme.title: Alarum
programme.desc: Kaks reetlikku spiooni jätavad oma patuse mineviku seljataha, abielluvad ja elavad eraldatud majakeses, kus neid ründavad aga luureagentuurid, otsides varastatud kõvaketast.

programme.title: Süngeim tund
programme.desc: "Süngeim tund" on dramaatiline ja inspireeriv lugu neljast nädalast aastal 1940, Teise maailmasõja alguspäevil. Ajal, mil Winston Churchill (Gary Oldman) on astumas Suurbritannia peaministri ametisse, seisab ta silmitsi ühe raskeima ja otsustavaima hetkega oma elus – kuidas pidada rahuläbirääkimisi Natsi-Saksamaaga ja kaitsta samas vankumatult oma rahva ideaale ning vabadust. Hitleri natsiarmee laastab peatumatult Lääne-Euroopat ning ka Ühendkuningriiki ähvardab Saksamaa sissetung. Situatsioonis, kus rahvas on sõjaks ettevalmistamata, kuningas olukorra suhtes skeptiline ja parteikaaslased õõnestamas tema positsiooni, peab Churchill sel ajaloo süngeimal tunnil oma südika juhtimise ja veenmisjõuga inimesi ühendama lootuses muuta maailma ajaloo kulgu.

programme.title: UFC. Ciryl Gane-Josh Hokit
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Maccabi - Olympiacos
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Valencia - Virtus
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Valencia - Virtus
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Decoded
programme.desc: What if the history you knew was only half the story? Brad Meltzer's Decoded investigates the other half: the secret history of the symbols and codes that surround us everyday. Best-selling author Brad Meltzer has been writing novels for more than a decade. He has studied and written about some of the most revered institutions and documents in human history, including the U.S. Supreme Court, the Presidency, the Secret Service, Wall Street and the Bible. Brad has assembled a team to investigate the countless clues and theories uncovered through his years of research, but unexplored until now. From the dollar bill to the first Presidential Codes, the hidden messages of the Statue of Liberty and the ciphers protecting the location of lost Confederate gold, the team uncovers the truth behind history's most provocative secrets.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: Before the mysterious disappearance of the ancient Maya, Belize was the nerve center of this advanced civilization. Hundreds of ruins dot the landscape and reveal clues to bloody Mayan rituals, advanced architecture and a belief in an unforgiving underworld of Mayan gods. Don ducks beneath the jungles of Belize to uncover burial tombs, sacrificial altars, ritualistic caves and the literal entrances to the Mayan underworld.

We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Warriors goes inside the culture of the most famous warriors of all time to explore their weaponry, tactics, training and, ultimately, their psyche. Every episode tells the dramatic story of one of the world's iconic warrior groups--Vikings, Spartans, Barbarians, Samurai--including the rituals, technology and strategy that made them so mighty. Warriors is hosted by Terry Schappert, a Green Beret and 17-year veteran currently serving in the US Special Forces. He delves deep into the mindset of a warrior, revealing what made these individuals rise above others to lead, to fight and sometimes to die. Each Warriors episode also explores a climactic battle that showcases the warrior's strengths, weaknesses and life-and-death struggle. From Zulus to English Knights to Hawaiians, Terry is fully immersed in the warrior culture--from the weapons used to the pre-battle rituals, to the initiations, to battlefield strategy and tactics. When delving deep into the Viking culture, he experiences first hand the fighting techniques and tests the weapons of the warriors that some call "the Hells Angels" of the Middle Ages. In the Samurai episode, Terry learns the secrets and traditions of the elite and mysterious warriors who for centuries ruled Japan. In English Knights, he dons the armor, uses the weapons and lives the code of chivalry. In every episode of Warriors, Terry talks to experts on each of the warrior cultures, moves beyond the stereotypes and gains new insights about who these men really were. Walking in the footsteps of history's greatest Warriors proves to be a gut-wrenching experience, but it's all part of Terry's amazing journey to discover the heart of a warrior.

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: On this episode, a massive explosion rocks a small Texas town killing 15 residents. A bridge in Washington collapses sending cars plunging into the river. Two construction cranes in New York City seem to fall from the sky leaving a path of destruction. A ferry full of passenger's encounters trouble and sinks. And a building demolition In Philadelphia goes horribly wrong killing innocent shoppers next door. What do all of these catastrophes have in common? They were caused by engineering failures that led to disasters of epic proportions.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: Pressure testing the FBI files the team starts the investigation in the small farming town of Charata, Argentina. Following leads embedded in the declassified files the investigation uncovers a school that was once part of the Nazi Youth movement as well as a prominent Nazi Carlos Buck who lived in the area. Furthering the investigation they also uncover a fortified storage facility with characteristics matching that of a military bunker in the area the FBI files place Hitler and a mysterious under anomaly on Carlos Buck's property.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Sacred bones... Golden hats... And fragments of sacred objects thought to possess healing properties. All around the world, archaeologists have uncovered mysterious relics revered by ancient cultures for thousands of years. Now on display in museums, temples and churches, millions of people travel great distances just to be in their presence. What is it about these ancient objects that draws people to them? Could the truth of mankind's origins be found in the fabric, metal, stone and bones of our distant past? And could these mysterious relics really provide us with the ability to access divine or otherworldly power?

programme.title: Food Tech
programme.desc: With Americans eating more than 85 billion tortillas a year, Mexican Food is very popular. But did you know that a donkey is a key to great tequila? Ever wondered how many times they refry refried beans? And what do sound waves have to do with guacamole? Watch host Bobby Bognar as he travels south of the border to help an old artist make a classic Mexican cooking dish from volcanic rock. On the high seas, he'll try to keep his cookies in a rough and tumble hunt for mahi mahi. And he'll show us how a fruit that resembles a human brain becomes a classic Mexican after-dinner drink.

programme.title: Modern Marvels: Food
programme.desc: Follow Adam Richman as he visits America's oldest candy store to see how they craft decadent chocolate treats. Then, discover how internationally recognised Theo Chocolate produces up to 2.5-million pounds of chocolate per year!

programme.title: Food Tech
programme.desc: Nothing beats the taste of a Southern fried meal--and host Bobby Bognar traces its amazing journey to your plate. In Alabama, Bobby wades among 275,000 catfish during feeding time--and discovers how each fish scooped from the pond becomes a fillet within just one hour. At a Louisiana alligator farm, he dares to grab a gator from its holding tank, and learns how gators owe their survival--in part--to those who eat them. Did you know that one popular Southern favorite, rice, reaches your plate by falling from the sky? Or what it takes to extract frying oil from a lint-covered cottonseed? Or what makes the South's favorite spicy condiment, Tabasco sauce, so hot? And what do giant fans, fire and cannons have to do with putting peach cobbler on the table?
