programme.title: Koonuspead
programme.desc: Tulnukapaar ja nende tütar teevad Maal hädamaandumise ja üritavad sulanduda äärelinna ühiskonda.

programme.title: Robot ja Frank
programme.desc: Endine juveelivaras saab pojalt kingituseks robotist ülemteenri, kes on programmeeritud tema eest hoolitsema. Kaks seltsilist proovivad peagi õnne röövlitena.

programme.title: Koerte hotell
programme.desc: Mahajäetud hotell, kuhu on kolinud hulkuvad koerad, jääb silma kahele lapsele. Neil ei lubata koeri koju tuua ja nad otsustavad teha koerale oma kodu, kus saaksid elada kõik kodutud koerad.

programme.title: Vaat kes ka räägib
programme.desc: Väikemees Mikey peab õppima elama koos uue õega, samal ajal kui tema ema ja isa õpivad samuti teineteisega kooselamist. Režissöör Amy Heckerling. Osades Kristie Alley, John Travolta, Bruce Willis, Olympia Dukakis jt.

programme.title: Riigipea
programme.desc: Presidendikandidaat sureb ootamatult keset kampaaniat ja Washingtoni linnanõunik Mays Gilliam määratakse sama ootamatult tema asemele.

programme.title: Kujuta ette
programme.desc: Edukat finantsanalüütikut ärritab tütre käitumine, kes klammerdub oma lemmikpleedi ja kujutletavate sõbrannade külge. Kuid nende nõuanded tõotavad tulu tuua.

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Kogu elu muu maailma eest kloostris varjatuna elanud noormees otsustab aidata munkadel teenida raha orbude heaks. Ta rüütab end maski, keepi ja trikoosse, et osaleda maadlusturniiril.

programme.title: Uljad uisuvelled
programme.desc: Mõne aasta eest võeti kahelt võistlevalt iluuisutajalt nii medalid kui õigus meeste üksikvõistlustel osaleda. Nad leiavad lünga, mis võimaldav neil osaleda paarisvõistlustel.

programme.title: Seksisemud
programme.desc: Romantiline hittkomöödia Dylanist (Justin Timberlake), kes on otsustanud teha suhetega lõpparve ja Jamie'st (Mila Kunis), kes tahab hoiduda tõelise armastuse hollywoodilikest klisheedest. Kui need kaks noort aga kohtuvad, otsustavad nad proovida midagi uut - kasutada ära nendevahelist keemiat, kuid vältida emotsionaalset seotust. Füüsiline nauding ilma koormavate suhete ja kohustusteta. Kõlab ju üsna lihtsalt? Mitte nii väga. Peagi mõistavad Dylan ja Jamie, et romantiliste komöödiate stereotüübid eksisteerivad põhjusega. Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Surm matusel
programme.desc: Ajal, mil leinajad Briti mõisas püüavad vapralt "suunurki üleval hoida", kujuneb väärikas matus täielikuks hirmnaljakaks läbikukkumiseks koos kadunud surnukehade, sündsusetute paljastuste ja šokeerivate peresaladustega.

programme.title: Suur Lebowski
programme.desc: USA / UK 1998 krimikomöödia Lavastaja: Joel Coen Osades: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Steve Buscemi, Julianne Moore, John Turturro Jeffrey "The Dude" Lebowski (Jeff Bridges) on mees, kes muutnud logelemise lausa omaette kunstivormiks. Tema rahulik elu pööratakse pea peale, kui ta korterisse tungivad kaks nalja mitte mõistvat selli, kes temalt raha nõuavad ja lõpuks vaiba peale urineerivad. Kui selgub, et mehed ajasid päevavarga segamini tema miljonärist nimekaimuga, otsustab Lebowski kogetud ülekohtu eest rahajõmmilt hüvitust nõuda ning vastutasuks kistakse pahaaimamatu tobuke inimröövide ja väljapressimiste ohtlikusse maailma, millele lisab tugevasti vürtsi tema sõjardist sõber Walter (John Goodman).

programme.title: Something in the Air
programme.desc: Written and directed by Olivier Assayas, Something in the Air is a poignant, semi-autobiographical film set in France a few years after the huge political and civil unrest of 1968, a borderline revolution that almost brought the country to a standstill. In 1971, a group of teenagers are still feeling the momentum of the movement, alongside disappointment that the dust is settling with little apparent change. Gilles (Clément Métayer) is finishing up at school and getting ready for art college, but his mind is filled with hard (and often conflicting) political ideologies, and as debates turn into demonstrations, and demonstrations turn into violent attacks against state, he meets more people who are angry with the political status quo, including Christine (Lola Créton), who's part of a film-making movement that celebrates the working class. Something in the Air is a moving and sometimes funny film about social inequality, and pays sound attention to a fascinating point of recent European history that is often overlooked.

programme.title: Enduring Love
programme.desc: Roger Michell's drama, based on Ian McEwan's novel, of unrequited love stars Daniel Craig as Joe, out with his girlfriend Claire (Samantha Morton) for a picnic in the countryside. Suddenly, over the trees, appears a hot-air balloon that lands, tipping out the pilot, and then rises again, leaving a young boy stranded in the basket. Joe and other bystanders grab the trailing ropes but, one by one, they are forced to let go as the balloon ascends, except for one person who is borne aloft, before falling to his fate. Joe and Jed (Rhys Ifans) find his body. For Claire and Joe, life returns to a semblance of normality, until Joe starts running into Jed - again and again. And as Jed's obsession grows, so does the danger to Joe and Claire.

programme.title: Cheri
programme.desc: During France's belle époque before World War I, elegant cars, mansions, and servants defined the lives of les grandes horizontals, the courtesans of kings and millionaires. One of the most successful, Lea de Lonval, is approaching a certain age when an older associate, Charlotte Peloux, asks Lea to take on her 19 year old son, whom Lea has called Chéri since he was a child. They become lovers and, to their surprise, the relationship lasts six years. When it ends abruptly with a marriage his mother arranges to the daughter of another courtesan, Lea finds herself miserable.

programme.title: Sol
programme.desc: Sol, a famous Argentine Tango performer, has lived in Buenos Aires for many years. Behind her excessive temper and her glowing smile, the Diva hides an injury from which she never really recovered: the loss of her only son, Raphaël.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: All Our Desires
programme.desc: Moved by the plight of the mother of her daughter's school friend, a young judge facing an incurable disease teams up with an older colleague in order to fight against financial companies that exploit the poor.

programme.title: The Unknown Country
programme.desc: Vids reviewed: * The Matrix * Manumission the movie * Another day in paradise * The guide to G spots and multiple orgasms * The six million dollar man * The bionic woman * Human traffic * Jeremy Clarksons Head to head Nige tells us that the car is the modern Black Death. And the guys pay tribute to police squad by doing the freeze frame sketch over the end credits.

programme.title: Ramen Shop
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients.

programme.title: Love Me No More
programme.desc: Antoine Méliot is around 40 years old and has everything he needs to be happy: a beautiful wife, two adorable children, friends he can count on, a pretty house in the Yvelines and money. But one day he decides to ruin everything in one weekend.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: 18th century England. Married at 17 to the rich and powerful Duke of Devonshire, Georgiana quickly charms high society with her stunning beauty, wit and love of life. However, behind this flamboyant image hides a woman who longs to be loved, a woman deserted by her husband - the only man in the kingdom indifferent to her charms - who prefers her best friend Elizabeth Foster, and who obliges her to accept a ménage à trois. Unhappy and unsatisfied, Georgiana leads a hectic social life. Her elegance, her extravagance and her taste for gambling create a sensation, particularly when she throws herself into politics alongside the Liberal Party. She's celebrated by princes and ministers. And she supports the young Member of Parliament, Charles Grey, with whom she falls passionately in love.

programme.title: The Cathedral
programme.desc: An unconventional autobiography, THE CATHEDRAL presents the complex tapestry of conflict-filled family relationships that will shape the life and future filmmaking career of Jesse, a kid growing up in New York from the 1980s to the mid-2000s. The film shows us the life of Jesse and his family at different stages like the chapters of a novel. Ricky D'Ambrose is one of those filmmakers whose style can be described as unique, apart from very specific vignettes, he uses photos, newsreels and TV commercials to convey the world as Jesse experiences it. At the same time, the film is fundamentally a biography of his problematic father, but also of his mother, stepfathers, uncles, aunts, grandparents and great-grandparents - the twisted "cathedral" that built the young man that Jesse would become.

programme.title: Certified Copy
programme.desc: Drama. French drama, produced in 2010. While in Tuscany to promote his latest book, a middle-aged British writer meets a French gallery owner woman who is also a fan of his books and they set off on a tour of Tuscany.

programme.title: 2 Days In Paris
programme.desc: Marion is a French-born photographer living in New York City with her Neurosis, hypochondriacal, chain-smoking, heavily tattooed American interior designer boyfriend Jack. After a markedly unromantic trip to Venice, which was planned to re-ignite the passion in their relationship, they take a night train to Paris to pick up Marion's cat from her parents and decide to stay for two days. Jack is startled to learn Marion has remained in contact with numerous ex-lovers and becomes increasingly uncomfortable due to the language barrier and a multitude of her old flames she keeps meeting. Meanwhile, Marion wrestles with her own insecurities about love, relationships, and her impulsive nature.

programme.title: Saint Frances
programme.desc: Critically acclaimed, offbeat comedy-drama written by and starring Kelly O'Sullivan. Thirty-something waiter Bridget (O'Sullivan) finds herself adrift in life. She's yet to begin the career she wants, because she doesn't know what she wants to be. And she's yet to settle down and start a family, because she doesn't know if she wants to get married and be a mum. Indecision rules in Bridget's life. When she takes a summer gig as a nanny for an at times rather demanding six-year-old, Frances (Ramona Edith Williams), Bridget starts learning some important life lessons from the child as well as her two mums, Maya (Charin Alvarez) and Annie (Lily Mojekwu). Sometimes, even the most together of people don't really know what they're doing. And maybe that's OK. Directed by Alex Thompson. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Comment c'est loin
programme.desc: After ten years of doing nothing, Orel and Gringe are in their mid 30s and they struggle to finish their first rap album. Their texts are mostly sex jokes and booze stories and reflect the everyday life they have in a small town from France. The problem is that they never really finished a song and when their producers want to meet, they have to face a new challenge : finish their first song in the next 24h. Their old issues, the fear of failure, their alcoholic friends and annoying girlfriends won't help them to do so, or will they ?

programme.title: Ratcatcher
programme.desc: The film opens focused upon James' friend Ryan Quinn, who is being forced to put on his wellington boots to go to visit his father, who is in jail. But Ryan chose to play with James instead, and runs off while his mother is not looking. Ryan meets James at the canal and during some rough-house play he is drowned, clearly with James bearing much of the blame for not having raised the alarm. James believes his inaction has gone unnoticed.

programme.title: An Argentinian Crime
programme.desc: Rosario in the 80s. The disappearance of a man during the military dictatorship. Two young people from the court must do everything possible to solve the case while facing police corruption and various dangers that put their lives at risk.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Tracy Chevalier's best-selling novel, inspired by the Johannes Vermeer painting of the same name. Set in mid-17th-century Delft, Holland, 17-year-old Griet is forced into servanthood when her father suffers an accident and becomes unable to work. She is taken on at the Vermeer household, where her presence immediately provokes hostility from members of the family - particularly the artist's wife and eldest daughter - when she starts to forge an understanding with her mysterious master.

programme.title: Neem Me Mee
programme.desc: Six people over seventy are at a turning point in their lives. Without knowing each other, they go on a journey together.

programme.title: The Painted Veil
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: On the eve of her wedding, a young woman meets the love of her life. They decide to spend the whole night together.

programme.title: Diane
programme.desc: Diane fills her days helping others and desperately attempting to bond with her drug-addicted son. As these pieces of her existence begin to fade, she finds herself confronting memories she'd sooner forget than face.

programme.title: The Practice
programme.desc: Gustavo, an Argentine yoga instructor living in Chile who recently lost his wife and home while an injury prevents him from continuing with his yoga practice.

programme.title: Like a Prince
programme.desc: Souleyman, a French boxing champion in preparation for the Olympic Games, sees his future crumble when he cracks the bones of his hand following a bar fight. He is sent to the Château de Chambord, where he must perform community service.

programme.title: Romantics Anonymous
programme.desc: Angélique is a young French woman who suffers from social anxiety disorder and is afraid of just about everything. She regularly attends a support group for other people like her. Jean-René, who owns a small manufacturer of chocolate called the Chocolate Mill, also suffers from social anxiety, and is afraid of many things, particularly intimacy. The Chocolate Mill is failing because it makes a plain, old-fashioned kind of chocolate that no longer sells well.

programme.title: A Clever Crook
programme.desc: Beffrois, a disillusioned police captain nearing retirement, has his curiosity aroused by a new art theft. Seemingly an art specialist, the burglar prefers works of average value. No doubt to avoid attracting attention. Another distinctive sign: he always passes by the roof. For Beffrois the investigation looks to be athletic. Direction, screenplay: Lucas Bernard (France, 2017)

programme.title: S*** in a Good Way
programme.desc: Charlotte couldn't be happier about her relationship with her handsome boyfriend. But during a moment of intimacy, the teen's beau drops a bomb on her: He's gay. She is crushed. So, along with her best friends - the sassy spitfire Megan and the quieter Aube - Charlotte seeks distraction at a toy store. There, the three girls are charmed by the young, male employees and quickly land jobs alongside them. Charlotte, still heartbroken, starts flirting - and having casual sex - with a few of her new coworkers. Initially, she loves her new freedom. Others around her, however, feel differently, leading them to smear Charlotte's name and challenge her newfound sexual empowerment.

programme.title: Chinese Puzzle
programme.desc: Ten years have passed, and the once happy lovers, Xavier Rousseau (Romain Duris) and Wendy (Kelly Reilly), have split. When she moves with their two children to New York City, he also moves to there to be near the children. Wendy now lives with John (Peter Hermann (actor)) in a luxury apartment overlooking Central Park. Xavier initially stays with Isabelle (Cécile de France) and Ju (Sandrine Holt), a lesbian couple whose child he fathered, but he soon finds his own apartment above a Chinese bakery where he works on a new novel assisted by brief visions of Arthur Schopenhauer and Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel.

programme.title: Chinese Puzzle
programme.desc: Ten years have passed, and the once happy lovers, Xavier Rousseau (Romain Duris) and Wendy (Kelly Reilly), have split. When she moves with their two children to New York City, he also moves to there to be near the children. Wendy now lives with John (Peter Hermann (actor)) in a luxury apartment overlooking Central Park. Xavier initially stays with Isabelle (Cécile de France) and Ju (Sandrine Holt), a lesbian couple whose child he fathered, but he soon finds his own apartment above a Chinese bakery where he works on a new novel assisted by brief visions of Arthur Schopenhauer and Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel.

programme.title: Breakfast on Pluto
programme.desc: Set in the 1970s, "Breakfast on Pluto" follows the exploits of Patrick Braden (Cillian Murphy), an endearing, witty, clever and deceptively tough young transvestite. Abandoned as a baby in his small Irish hometown, Patrick is aware from a very early age that he has been born into the wrong body. He survives this harsh environment with the aid of his wit and charm, plus a sweet refusal to let anyone and anything change who he is. With a burning desire to find his mother and reconciliation, he moves to London, and a hilarious, memorable and emotional series of misadventures sees Patrick, or Kitten as he prefers to be called, finally finding the love and happiness he craves.

programme.title: A Clever Crook
programme.desc: Beffrois, a disillusioned police captain nearing retirement, has his curiosity aroused by a new art theft. Seemingly an art specialist, the burglar prefers works of average value. No doubt to avoid attracting attention. Another distinctive sign: he always passes by the roof. For Beffrois the investigation looks to be athletic. Direction, screenplay: Lucas Bernard (France, 2017)

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: The Unknown Country
programme.desc: Vids reviewed: * The Matrix * Manumission the movie * Another day in paradise * The guide to G spots and multiple orgasms * The six million dollar man * The bionic woman * Human traffic * Jeremy Clarksons Head to head Nige tells us that the car is the modern Black Death. And the guys pay tribute to police squad by doing the freeze frame sketch over the end credits.

programme.title: Ramen Shop
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients.

programme.title: Love Me No More
programme.desc: Antoine Méliot is around 40 years old and has everything he needs to be happy: a beautiful wife, two adorable children, friends he can count on, a pretty house in the Yvelines and money. But one day he decides to ruin everything in one weekend.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: 18th century England. Married at 17 to the rich and powerful Duke of Devonshire, Georgiana quickly charms high society with her stunning beauty, wit and love of life. However, behind this flamboyant image hides a woman who longs to be loved, a woman deserted by her husband - the only man in the kingdom indifferent to her charms - who prefers her best friend Elizabeth Foster, and who obliges her to accept a ménage à trois. Unhappy and unsatisfied, Georgiana leads a hectic social life. Her elegance, her extravagance and her taste for gambling create a sensation, particularly when she throws herself into politics alongside the Liberal Party. She's celebrated by princes and ministers. And she supports the young Member of Parliament, Charles Grey, with whom she falls passionately in love.

programme.title: The Cathedral
programme.desc: An unconventional autobiography, THE CATHEDRAL presents the complex tapestry of conflict-filled family relationships that will shape the life and future filmmaking career of Jesse, a kid growing up in New York from the 1980s to the mid-2000s. The film shows us the life of Jesse and his family at different stages like the chapters of a novel. Ricky D'Ambrose is one of those filmmakers whose style can be described as unique, apart from very specific vignettes, he uses photos, newsreels and TV commercials to convey the world as Jesse experiences it. At the same time, the film is fundamentally a biography of his problematic father, but also of his mother, stepfathers, uncles, aunts, grandparents and great-grandparents - the twisted "cathedral" that built the young man that Jesse would become.

programme.title: Certified Copy
programme.desc: Drama. French drama, produced in 2010. While in Tuscany to promote his latest book, a middle-aged British writer meets a French gallery owner woman who is also a fan of his books and they set off on a tour of Tuscany.

programme.title: Flash Gordon
programme.desc: Mike Hodges' film is a gloriously kitsch update of the 1930s comic strip and film series, starring Sam J Jones as the American football star Flash Gordon, who's transported, along with the beautiful Dale Arden (Melody Anderson), by Dr Zarkov (Topol) into the realm of the most evil ruler in the universe, the Emperor Ming (Max von Sydow). Only by uniting those under Ming's merciless rule to join his revolution can Flash save Earth from destruction. The unashamedly over-the-top Queen soundtrack is matched by Danilo Donati's effervescent production design, and the film also stars Brian Blessed as the chief of the Hawkmen, Timothy Dalton as the leader of the Treemen, and Ornella Muti as Ming's daughter, whose lascivious designs on Flash are just one of the challenges he must overcome if he's to end Ming's tyranny.

programme.title: The Third Man
programme.desc: Classic film noir about an American writer who visits postwar Vienna to see an old friend, but is told that his friend is dead. Incredulous at the suggestion his friend was a criminal, the writer attempts to clear the dead man's name, but soon finds events taking a strange turn - his friend is very much alive, dealing drugs on the black market.

programme.title: Hidden Beauties
programme.desc: Two young Tunisian women strive for the same emancipation enjoyed by men.

programme.title: Youth
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Harvey Keitel star in this comedy-drama about ageing from Italian director Paolo Sorrentino (The Great Beauty). Retired classical music conductor and composer Fred Ballinger (Caine) is holidaying at a plush hotel in the Swiss Alps with his best friend, the veteran film director Mick Boyle (Keitel). It's supposed to be relaxing, but Ballinger's tranquillity is disturbed by an emissary of the Queen, who wants him to perform one last time for her. Meanwhile, Boyle is fretting because funding for his latest (and, he hopes, greatest) project relies on him securing the participation of his long-time leading lady Brenda Morel (Jane Fonda). The two men also pointedly and ruefully reflect on their lost youth and opportunities; something that's not helped by the current Miss Universe's (Madalina Ghenea) penchant for shedding her clothes whenever she bathes in the hot tub with them. Also starring Rachel Weisz as Ballinger's daughter, who's married to Boyle's son (Tony Dano).

programme.title: The Young Lovers
programme.desc: Elegant, retired architect Shauna (70) crosses paths with Pierre, a happily married doctor in his 40s, who first made an impression on her in a brief meeting 15 years previously. Both are quite troubled to meet again and begin an affair. While Pierre's family life is soon turned upside down, Shauna struggles with feelings she thought belonged to the past.

programme.title: Võimsatel jõgedel
programme.desc: Metsik ja läbitamatu Aafrika ikoon - Zambezi jõgi - on koht, kus leidub maailma võimsaim juga, hirmuäratavad kärestkud ja inimsööja-krokodillid.Jeremy uurib, miks see võimas jõgi on hädas.

programme.title: Kiskja mõttemaailm
programme.desc: Merisiilidest kilpkonnade ja korallidest haideni - korallrahudel elab hästi palju erinevaid liike, kelle erilised kohastumused aitavad neil oma elupaigas edukalt hakkama saada.

Õnneks pole seal sel korral suuri lihavarusid, ent paharet tuleb kindlaks teha ja abinõud tarvitusele võtta. Jessie võtab ette kahepäevase sõidu rakendiga, et Mintosse tervenema jäänud koer ära tuua. Sue otsustab püstitada sauna.
